This is an example with our internal dataset, first take a look at the data structure

```{r}
#| label: load data
library(ecoSynthesis)
data("TASVEG_xref")
head(TASVEG_xref)
```

Here we can use the function `membership_tbl` directly.

```{r}
#| label: create membership table
#| error: true
TASVEG_tbl <- TASVEG_xref |>
  membership_tbl(
    source_id = "VEGCODE",
    target_id = "efg",
    membership = "memb",
    interpreter = "interp"
  )
class(TASVEG_tbl)
print(TASVEG_tbl)
check_membership(TASVEG_tbl)
validate_membership(TASVEG_tbl)
```
